packageRules.description: Group same-ecosystem minor/patch bumps into one PR instead of one-per-package noise.

Automerge disabled everywhere - this project closes accounts irreversibly, and CONTRIBUTING.md already asks for closer review on anything security-sensitive. A dependency bump is reviewed like any other change, never merged unattended.

@stellar/stellar-sdk is pinned to an exact version via the root `overrides` on purpose (see CLAUDE.md: mixing its CJS/ESM builds across the two package managers' resolution breaks js-xdr identity). Never opened as an automatic PR; still tracked on the dashboard so a real update (e.g. a security fix) isn't missed, but bumping it is a deliberate, manually-triggered change.
Security fixes bypass the weekly schedule and PR concurrency limit - waiting until Monday for a vulnerable dependency defeats the point of scanning for one.
